tei:div.tei:p: (513)rta mgrin yang phung nag po'i samad las las bzhi'i gsal byed drang srog dmod pa'i mchon cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (514)

thugs rjes khros pa rta gdong 'bar ba'i mes/ ma rungs 'byung po phyin ci log pa'i rlan/ skad cig mdo la phye mar za byed pa/ dbang chen ma hā kā las rjes skyongs shig /snyigs dus 'di na dmu rgod sems la/ rgyal bsen gza' klu byad phur kha dar nas/ mi rlungs gdon tshogs 'joms la rab bsngag pa/ drag po'i las kyi phrin las 'di na spel/ de yang dus dang gza' skra bzogang 'jom par dben pa'i gnas su/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsu pa khrag dang po la bas byugs/ dbus su khri'um miñdza'i khar khro zang bsam lcags kyi snod gang rung gi nang du 'bru zan la dpal bsos zur gsum pa shin tu 'gying bag can la bshes phran brgyad kyis bskor ba bshams/ khrag gis bug la bong sha ma gtogs pa'i sha sna tshogs tshad kyis brgyan/ mda' dar sogs stod bcas rnams tshang bar bshams/smad bcas tsher (515) nag gi phur pa rkang gang*/ su ri bru gsum mtho gang ba khong seng can thun lam can gyi 'on tu gru gsum he khung rdzas can dang*/ sgrub rkyang la zan gyi nya bo dur khrod/ kyi khu sha la nṛ tri bris pa'i srog rtsa can gyis chog la/ khyad par las phye brag sgor du bya bar 'dod na/ rgyud las/ da ni dgos pa tha ma'i don/ mtshon tsha lta bu'i man ngang ni/ drag sngags las la sbyar ba na/ mes tshig g.yul 'byed mda' 'apen pa/ khang rdib yul shog grong brdal pa/ gsha' 'ud sa zhig dur khrod pa/ phung shul grog rkam pa rnams la/ su ri zur gsum mtho gang ba/ bang rim dgu ba khong gseng bya/ 'og tu gu gsum rkang gang ba/ kha khyer rdzab dang ldan par bya/ gnyis kī phying drug chu dang*/ dur yol dag gis nag por bya/ nang ni khrag dang btsag gis byugs/ bru gsum kha la rtsang gis (516) bskor/ suri'i kha la thun lam bya/ tsher nag phur pa rkang gang la/ drag sngags bris pas thun lam bya/ de nas dgra gegabyad ma sogs/ gang la bya ba'i liṅga yi/ srog yig sngags them tshang bar bri bru gsum gan rgyal gzhug

khyad par bgegs la kha bsgyur rdzas/bsad par 'dod na gri khrag gis/ lkug par 'dod na phug ron khrag /wa rengs 'dod na khug rta'i khrag /smyo bar 'dod na smyo klad chu// dbye 'dod bya rog 'ug pa'i khrag /pho gdon rgyal po khyi dkar khrag mo gdon rgyal mo khyi nag khrag gza' la gza' ra rog po'i khrag /klul glang dmar sbal sbrul khrag batshan la sha khyi dmar po'i khrag /bdud la g.yag nag rog po'i khrag gshin rje gri rgod khrag gis bri/ the'u rang ra kham khrag gis bri/ tshung sri bye la'i khrag gis bri/ zhes dgra bgegs gang la byed pa'i lingag yang*/ so so'i gzung ci lta ba bzhin bya/ bya ma dang dgra la byed na dpral bar rus/ snyig gar nṛ la ming gis bskor/ spyi bor sum/ 'drin par dung*/ lte bar ram/ 'doms sa phaṭa/ brla la rbod/ dpung pa la ching*/ phrag gong g.yas la dzaḥ g.yon la hūṃ: mkha' zur g.yas la bam/ gon par ho/ de rgyab sngags tshang mas bskor/ sngags mgo nad du bstan la dril/ rdzas ni khrag sna rnams gzhung du gsal bzhin bya'o/ bgegs la phyed (517) na liṅga rnams ni 'dre gag yin pa soso'i gzugs bris/ spyi bor nan/ dpral bar ming snying ngar tri la khug dza dzaḥs bskor/ lte bar mā ra ya rbad/ yan lag la tshings shig dzaḥhūṃ bam hos/ khyad par snying ga'i tri zhabs su rgyal po la tsa/ gshin rjer ya/ ma mor ma/ bdud la du/ btsan la ru/ gza' la ra/ 'dre spyil tri kho nas tshog liṅga sngar ltar sngags kyis bskor/ mi 'gyur rdzas gcig khong du btang*/ zhes bar zhal zhes yod/ liṅga ner gnyis dang*/ gzhan yag drag po'i thun rdzas sna dgu ni/ yungs dkar yungs nag ram rgod/ ke tsha shing tsha thang phroṃ gsum/ zangs phye lcags phye rdo phye rnams/ drag sngags ra blud thun gyis brab/ ces than rdzas rnams la dug khrag gis sbol bas nus pa che'o/ de ltar chas rnams grub nas/ sgrub pa dgos la/ dang po mdun bskyed gsal ba ni/

bstan pa dang sems gyi don du deng nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bskul zhing*/ rta mgrin nag po'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ ba hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rdo rje'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang cu/ skad gcig gis grub gsum mthing nag (118)'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ mdun rten gtor ma khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ drag po'i spyan gsum bsgrad cing*/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas sgrol byed kyi ral dris dgra gegs dum bur gtub pa/ g.yon 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyus dgra gegs kyi srog snying 'dren pa/ zhab gnyis dgra gegs non par gnon pad/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad drag po rnam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing sid gsum ma lus zil gyis mnon pa/ sku stong la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dag*/thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba// bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klog na bzhugs pa/ dbu skra gnam lcags kyi ral pa bsigs pa'i sgra gseb nas khro (519)chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa phyir 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ khro chung thams cad tshur 'dus srung ba'i gur du bsam/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren nas bstod pa phrin las bcol ba'i rnams grub par byas te/ gsum pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag mdan gnyis kyi thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' bskor du/ rtsa ba'i sngags phreng dmar po g.yas su 'khor te/ rang gi thugs kī hūṃ las sngags phreng 'od zer me dang bcas rang gi zhal nas phar 'phros/

mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las thim/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon/ lte ba nas tshur phyung*/ rang gi lte ba nas tshur zhugs thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon/ lte ba nas tshur phyung*/ rang gi lte ba nas tshur zhugs thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ de bzhin du sngags phreng ba thag khrid pa ltar dmar sga ra ga 'khor ba las/ me dpung tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing dbang drag gis las thams cad 'grub par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ ba hūṃ phaṭa/ (520)yak+sha nag po nṛ tri hur thum dzaḥ nas/ u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ bar gyi rtsa sngags dag las sngags sbrel la me dpung 'bar ba ltar drag la rtsub par bzlo'o las sbyor las sngags rkyang ma bzla gsungs pas las bcu gnyis po'i char ser 'gugs gsum gzhan du shes/ zhes de gsum po ma gtogs pa las spyi dgos gang bstan pa kun 'di kho nas chog gnod byed zer ba'i ma lus dgra gegs byad ma'i ming gzhug par byas la/ las sngags ser chen 'beb pa ltar shin tu mtho zhing drag la myur bar bzla'o/ ba bsreg pa'i btso ba la rgyud nas las sngags kho nas chog par gsungs kyang*/ zhal rgyun la dang po bsnyen pa'i sngags 'di khri gsum man chad las sbyor la sngags 'di stong rtsa tsom dgos par gsungs pa ni/ oṃ dkar bram ze/ dmar bram ze/ me bram ze/ de la ho bram ze/ khro chu bram ze/ rbad bram ze sod swā hā/ zhes pa dang po bsnyen pa them nas btso bskol ba'i phyag len chags med rin po ce'i gsungs las shes so/ smad kyi las dag 'brel ba bzlog pa thal mo sdeb chog ni/ g.yas pa lcag la g.yon pa zangs/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug re re bsam/ zangs 'khor rtsibs drug nag du ni/ yang sprul sdig pa nag po drug/ mgo dgu nag du kha phogs nas/

khyad par (521)zangs 'khor lte ba ru/ nṛ las dgra dngos tshud par bsam/ lag gnyis thal mo sbubs pa yis/zangs lcags 'khor lo g.yas g.yon 'khor/ dgra bo yos ltar 'thag par bsam/ drag sngags bzlas shing thal mo sdeb/ brag la sgo nga brdab pa bzhin/ dgra bo chal chal po bar bsam/ sha khrag rus pa rtsibs bar gyi/ sdig pas hab gyis zos par bsam/ zhes sngags yak+sha nag po man da brgya re thon pa dag*/ thal mo dgu re brdab nas sngags stong phrag res las rnams 'grub pas phal la ma ston rag la sdig/ bstan dgra 'dul ba'i mtshon char shog ces pa 'di yang cung zad bzla'o/ bzhi pa las kyi khyad par la/ dgra gegs spyi yi bas las/ bye brag dgos kyi las bcu gnyis las/ dang po spyi yi las la/ dang po bsaskul ba ni/ hūṃ: gru gsum mthig nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ rta mgrin nag po sku bzhengs shig /gnado sbyin ga po sku bzhengs shig /las mkhan nag po= bzhengs shig chos (522)kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ chos dbyangs dag las las ma g.yos kyang*/ gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i sku/ sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa la/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad/ spyi gtsug rta bu ljang ku na tsher ba yis/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud*/ sku la dar nag ber chen gsol bayis/ dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon/ dbu la tho skam lngi sa brgyan pa ni/ rig pa'i bang rdzogs don dam gyes pa'i rtags/ dbu skra lcags kyi rol pa bsegs pa las/ khro chung mang pos dgra gegs tshar gcod mdzad/ snyan nas drag po'i 'brug sga sgrog pa yis/ dgra bgegs ma lus zil gyis gnon/ spyan nas me mi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba yis/ dgra bgegs ma lus bsreg par byed/ shangs nas drag po'i dud rlung 'bud pa yis/ dgra bgegs ma lus gtor bar byed/ zhal nas drag po'i gad rgyag sgrog pa yis/ dgra bgegs ma lus brgyal bar byes/

me ba dkor zur gsum gcigs pa yis(523)dgra bgegs ma lus za bar byed/ g.yas pas sgrol byed ral gri brnams pa yis// dgra bgegs mgo lus dum bur phral ba'i rtags/ phyag g.yon 'dzin byed lcags kyu brnams pa ni/ dgra gegs ma lus snying nas 'dren pa'i rtags/ zhabs gnyis rol ba'i rta bro brdung ba ni/ dgra gegs thal bar brlag par byed pa'i rtags// thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa ni/ dgra bgegs bsgral nas thugs dam bskang ba'i rtags/ sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol ba ni/ nyon mongs gnas su dag par byed pa'i rtags/ sku smad stag lpags sham thabs gsol ba ni/ nga rgyal dug lnga rad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ ba spu'i gabeb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro/ rgyal rigs rje rigs mangs sding bral ze'i rigs/ gdug pa ha la gnyan chen sde brgyad dang*/ nā ga klu rgyal 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ rgyal bsen 'byung po thal ba rdul durlog/ bsku le yak+sha mthu bo che/ rbad do dam nyams dgra la rbad/ ma g.yel srung ma (524)thugs dam can/ dam chosastan gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod/ rnal 'byor sku tshe khyed kyis srings/ yon bdag bar chad khyed kyis sol/ sdang ba'i dgra la rtags phyungs sig gnod pa'i bgegs ma las mdzod cig khyod kyi phrin las la babs// dus la bab po sa ma yā/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ ces bskul nas/ gnyis pa gser skyems la/ chang phud dang khrag phud sman rnams so sor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūṃ: rdo rje 'chad dbang shāka thub spyan ras gzigs/h+ya gṛ wa pad+ma tod phreg rtsal/ khri song sde'u btsan ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ spul pa'i gter chen nyi ma 'od zer dang*/ rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang spyan sngar khas blangs shing*/ dam bca' srog snying phul ba'i srug ma'i tshogs/ snag srid dregs pa sde brgyad da tshu byon/

lha dbang brgya byin lha min thag bzang ris/ klud la dga' bo bya rog mgo brtsegs dang*/ tsangs pa dang ni ljon pa rta mgo can (525)lang ka mgrin bcu bdu rgyal dmu rje btsan/ phyi yi lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten zhe sdang las gyi dregs pa can/ pho rgyud tshogs rnams chang gi macod pa bzhes/ 'jig rten 'dod chags las kyi dregs pa can/ mo rgyud tshogs rnams mar chen khrag mchod bzhes/ 'jig rten gti mug las gyi dregs pa can/ klu rgyud tshogs rnams dkar mngar rtsi sman dag*/ rang rang rigs mthun mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ sog ma med dag ma mo tsa mun ti/ gshin rje dmar po gza' bdud rgyal po dag*/ batshan bdud nag po bdud mo gser mig ma/ yul lha ma hā de wa 'brug sgrog sman/ nang gi dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang las kyi= pho rgyud tshogs rnams= 'jig rten 'dogs las kyi= mo rgyud tshogs/ 'jig rten gti mug= klu rgyud tshogs rnams dkar mngar rtsi sman dang*/ rang rang rigs mthun mchod pa 'bul= dbang phyug lha chan 'chi bdag mgo dgu klu/ gshin chen chos rgyal e ka tsa (526)ti dang*/ rol ba skya gcig srin po rak+sha nag gnod sbyin lo ka tsa ra khyab 'jug che/ gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rtan zhe sdang las kyi dregs pa can/ bdud yin mtshan/ pho rgyud zhogs rnams ngangi = 'ji rten 'dod chags las kyi= mo rgyud zhogs rnams dmar chen= 'jig rten gcati mug= klu rgyud tshogs rang rang rig mthun= bya nā a ka rmu bdud ha ling ka mu kha le dang srin po rak+sha nag ma mo gsod bye rol po glog 'gyur dang*/ ak+sha ha la bya rog mgo brtsegs bdud/ sbas pa'i dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang = pho rgyud= 'jig rten 'dod chogs las= kyu btsan yin mtshan/ mo rgyud tshogs= gshin rje/ 'jig rten gti mug=

lud rgyud= rang rang = yab rje nag po dkar po snying 'byin dang*/ yul lha phya sangs dpal mgon nag po dang*/ dam chen rdor legs srin po srog gi bdag gnam the'u dkar po sgrol ging yam shud dmar/ re ma ti sogs bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ dregs pa sde brgyad ma lus 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang = pho rgyud (527)'jig rten 'dod chags/ 'jig rten gtu mgu glu rgyud tshogs rnams dkar mngar rtsi sman dang*/ rang rang rigs mthun mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ sbrul mgo can ban rmu rje ya ba ti/ bdud pho bkrag med srin po srog gcod nag glu bdud sbul zhags gnod sbyin srog gcod nag ma mo nag mo khrag 'jag ma logs/ drag po sngags kyi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang*/ pho rgyud tshogs/ 'jig rten 'dod chags/ mo rgyud tshogs rnams/ 'jig rten gti mug glu rgyud tshogs/ rang rang rigs/ gling bzhi gling phran gnam pa bar snang dang*/ gnas yul dur khrod mtsho gling 'bab chu dang*/ sa rdo ri brag lha khang rgyal po'i khab/ rang rang yul gnas dang ming srog la/ btags shing chags pa'i sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang*/ pho rgyud/ 'jig rten 'dod chags/ mo rgyud tshogs/ 'jig rten gti mug glu rgyud/ rang rang rigs/ gnyan chen thang lha g.ya' spang skyes gcig dang*/ kye'u glung ban ban chen ru tra dang*/ (528)he le 'bar ma zur phud can dang ni/ bya rog pa ti rgyal po shing bya can/ lha bdud sum brgya drug cu'i sde la sogs/ btags chags ma chags sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten zhe sdang = pho rgyud tshogs rnams cag gi= 'jig rten 'dod= mo rgyud tsogs rnams= 'jig rten gti mug= klu rgyud tshogs= rang bzhin rigs mthun= sbal mgo khrag dmig ye shes shud dmar po dang*/ li byin har legs lang pa dmar po dang*/ gnod sbyin thod dkar shan pa nag po bdud/ bgegs kyi glang po smug po lcags thod can/

las byed myur gamogs sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ bdud nag tshogs dang dmor po btsan gyi tshogs/ rgyal po'i tshogs dang klu rigs lnga yi tshogs/ gnod sbyin tshogs dang dregs pa gza' yi tshogs/ phying gsang ba'i bstan skyong drag sngags dang*/ btags chags las byed 'das dang ma 'das kyi/ dregs pa sde (529)brgyad yab yum sras sprul 'khor/ pho nya bzhon pa rang sde dpung gi tshogs/ pho rgyud mnyes phyir gamos byedachang rgod dang*/ mo rgyud mnes phyir rak+ta dar chane dang*/ klu rnams mnyes phyir dkar mngar rtsi m+san sogs/ rang rigs mthun mchod pa 'bul gyas bzhes/ sngags 'chang yid la brnag pa'i dgra dang bges/ las rnams gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ gzugs ling ming dang mtshan ma dkar cags la/ btab pa'i nyams pa sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/

cais dang gser skyems phul/ gsu pa gzu dpang yus ba ni/ kyai/ sangs rgyas cos la dgra byung na/ dam chen sung ma ra mda' ldog/ thugs rje chen po gzu dang dpang*/ gar gyi byang chub= dbang gi rgyal po= rta mgrin nag po= yak+sa nag po= lha srin sde brgyad= las ngan sdig can dgra gro 'dis/ shākaya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa bshigs/ theg pa che la bskur pa btab/ dge bdun 'dus pa'i dkor la brkus/ mi dge (530)bcu po dang du blang sa/ dam chen yongs la do ru brdos/ sangs rgyas chos la bden med zer/ srung ma khyod la mthu med zer/ bdag gis ma nyes kho yis nyes/ chags pa med pa'i bu lon bdas/ byas pa med pa'i srog la rgo/ de bas bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur/ zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig po che/ sdig can myur du ma bsgral na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa gshig /srung ma dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ de bas srung ma dam ma g.yel/ de bas srung ma mthu ma chung*/ debs srung ma rtsal ma zhan/ dus la bab po sa ma yā/ bzhi ba dgra bgegs spyi dang khyad par byad ma bsad pa'i las gnyis po la bcas kyi khyad par spyir liṅkang dgra la nṛ dang bgegs la tri dang byad ma rag gshed dbab pa la bcas bye brag tu/ bag zag la sta bo byad ma'i ming gzugs ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ de'i khog tu liṅga dang zag rdzas mchil snab dri ma gos dum za 'phro rjes pa rnams bcug la/ lag g.yas se shing gi pur bu bzung du bcug la grum nang du mato rag la brtags nas rkyal du bzhug yang bag zan la byad ma kho rag gi (531) lha srung gang yin pa de'i gzugs shig byas la/ se shing gi phur chung gcig bzung bcug la byad ma'i gzugs de'i steng du kha sbabs su bzhag la/ skud pa sngo mar gyis byad dam lha srung gnyis ka'i rke la btags nas yar sne su ri'i thun lo gyi cher nag gi phur pa'i mgul du btags pa'i khyad par ro/ las gnis po la byad dam lha srung dam bcas pa rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs la bstim pa dag gcig

bdagu pa'i rjes kyis lha dag dbye zhing sngags kyi nus pa bshig pa dag gnyis/ kho yi lha rang gshed dbab pa dag gsum/ snying khrag srog rtsa gcod pa rnam shes rten dang bral nas bsad pa dang*/ bzi po 'di rta nag rang gi sgob chos gzhan la med pa yin pas go rim de bzhin du nge nas/ dang po e ram dzā la ram zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi gru gsum de lcags bsregs kyi khag sgrom nag la zab cing phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ nang na 'dod chags kyi krag mtsho 'khyil ba/ phying mder gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs se gtib pa/ nga rgyal gyi mtshon cha gzengs pa/ phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i dug lnga rang gshed du 'beb pa'i btson khang sgo med pa sra zhing 'thas pa'i rang bzhin du (532)gsal ba'i nang du gang la bya ba'i dmigs bya ri rtsing nyams thag pa'i rna par grum gya nang du dngos su tshud nas gar yang 'gro dbang med par bsam/ steng gi su ri nag po de gnam lcags kyi ri rab shin tu 'gying zhing dpa' ba gcig du gyur ba'i bang rim la gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ su ri'i kha'i phur pa de khro bo nag po 'jigs su rug ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sgrol byed kya ral dri klad la phyar ba/ g.yon pas 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ spyan gsu bsgrad cing smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ gnam lcags kyi ral pa can/ spyi gtsug tu rta dbu ljangu rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba/ thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ thod rlon gyi de shal dang*/ zhing lpags kyi stong g.yog can ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ lte ba man chad gnam gyi phur pa zur gsum pa/ gang la byed pa'i (533)snying gzir nus pa des/ kho'i rnam par shes pa gzir zhig phur pa'i dbal po las mtshon cha'i char babs pas dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i phung po dum bur gtub par

bsam la/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid zhe sdang drag po'i shugs/ rta mgrin khros pa'i ga rgyal gyis/ sku las sprul pa'i khro chug tshogs/ tho ba lcags lcags kyu thogs pa 'phros/ lhas byin snying nas lcags kyus zungs/ tho bas klad nas bcom par brdung*/ rang dbang med par bkug cing bstim/ ces dang*/ rang dang las mkhan gyi thugs ka nas khro bo dang khro mo grangs med pa spros te/ dzaḥlas lcags kyu can 'apros pas dgra bgegs kyi sngon nṛ tri la 'khyud nas rang dbang mdor bkug nas mdu gyi leng ka la yag yang bstim mo/ bden pas bkug pa ni/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dag chos kyi= dge bdun gyi= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bau 'dis sangs rgyas (534)kyi bstan pa bshig dkon mchog gsu gi dbu 'phang smad/ sngags bdag la do bsdos/bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba 'di dzaḥhūṃ bam hoḥ nṛ aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bgegs la tri aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ ces lan gsum dang*/ lde'u mig bdun pa yas/ lde'u mig 'di dang mi ldan na/ bsad las byed pa don med yin/ khyad par 'gugs lde'u mig 'di/ dgra gegs gang la byed pa yi/thog mar khug rtags ma byung bar/ 'di la 'bad pa man ngag yin/ ces/ yak+sha nag po nṛ hur thum dzaḥ che ge mo/ bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ri ti thuṃ thuṃ/ myog myog yer yer/ sha ma ru ti khug khug lig*/ gamog ling*/ sha ling thuṃ/tsa mun tri bh+yo/ dzaḥ'uṃ bam hoḥ bla ma khug na bsad las don mod/ khug zin bkug na lha srin khros sa rang la ldog pas tshod zin par bya'o/ de yang 'bod pa'i dus su rang nyid snying mi dga'/ blo mang*/ ngu snying 'od/ 'dug mi tshug sngags bzlas lhag chad yang*/ de'i dus su bla rtags byung na rang dang srung ma'i bla rtags yin pas bsgralas las byas na ra nga phung zhing brlag pa des lan/

gzhan gyi bla 'gram ni rag gis sems kyang mi brtan pas bla 'khyam don med mi bsgral (535) rbad pa'i dus su rag yag rngam rngam gcig gcig khro snying 'dod/ de dus bla rtags byung na dgra bo'i bla yin pas myur du las sbyor bya'o/ byas na dgra myur du 'chi'o/ liṅka mdor bla 'gugs na ri dwags med par khyi bskye ba dang 'dra/ ma khug par sgral na 'bem mdor mda' 'phen pa dang 'dra/ khug nas ma bsgral na ri dwags sgug ri'i nang nas shor ba dang 'dra/ bla ni rab dag dngos gzugs su 'ong*/ 'bring lba rtags dngos su 'ong*/ tha ma rmi lam du bla rtags bla chen drug sprul pa drug dang bcu gnyis las/ bla chen ni rta glag sha ba lug khyi phag rnams yin/ spul pa bong drel/ g.yag bya snge dang*/ gna' ba/ spyang ku ra dang drug 'ong*/ de ltar bla rtags nam byung na/ rag nyi skra brjes gtser bu bya/ ngo dang lag par khrag gi byugs/ shin tu khros pa'i sems kyis bsgral lo/ zhe sdang med na sgrol mi nus so/ gnyis pa lha pa bshig pa ni/ de'i dus na dgra bo skyob pa'i lha dang mi gnyis kyi bar du phra mam bcug nas dgra bo lha dang phral na gsod sla bas tshangs pa'i tshad dang ldan yag myur du 'aci bas/ kho'i skyob pa'i lha rtags dngos nyams rmi lam du sngags pa byung na chos skyong yin/ bon po dag bya tsang byung na bon srung yin/ bya chen byung na mkhar gyi rtse lha yin/ mi dkar byung (536) na lhag cig skyes lha yin/ lug dang g.yag dkar byung na yul lha yin k+s+yes pa 'khor gsum btags pa byung na pho lha yin/ khra spyang g.yag gsu byang na dgra lha yin/ rta dkar dang rang khyi'i rmug pa byung na srog lhi yin/ bya go bo byung na khang lha yin/ bud med sha ba byung na ma lha yin pas de rnams phye ba la/ bdug pa'i rdzas/ khyi ra gnyis kyi spu/ bya 'ug gnyis kyi sha dag*/ bzhi bo sgrub khang gi phyi rol du laṅka khyer lo bdug ste/

dud pa sgrubakhang dang rang la mi phog pa dgos/ phog na rnal 'byor ba rang nyid lha dang dbye bas lag len zhib dgos/ phyi tsal la gu gul gyi da pas bdud la/ hūṃ: ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal/ dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs/ bdag ni ma lanan ma nyes po/ dam nyams dgra bo che ge mo yis/ rnal 'byor bdag la slaha med zer/ srung ma khyod la mthu med zer bdag dang srung ma'i sku la brdos/ de bas myur du lha dang phyes/ myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzos/ ces bsgul nas pho rog dag 'ug sgros skyob pa'i lha bcu gsum dang dbye ba'i sngags rgyas/ yak+sha nag po mnag chad kyi las sngags spu bri 'bar ba'i sngags shams/ ru tra hab le hob (537)(538) las sgas gnam lcags spu gri ni/ yaka sha nag po nṛ tri hur thuṃ dzaḥ gnod byed mā ra ya srog la rbad rbad/ snying la rbad rbad/ rtsa la rbad rbad/ khrag la rbad rbad/ sha la rbad rbad/ rus pa la rbad rbad/ klad pa la rbad rbad/ yad la rbad rbad/ tsirta zungs zungs/ tsirta rmugs rmugs/ tsirta phyungs phyungs/ tsirta gtubs gtubs/ tsirta myog myog sirta thuṃ ril/ ya ya/ bh+yo bh+yo/ srog rtsa chod chod/ snying rtsa phyungs phyungs/ kham̐ kham̐/ lam̐ lam̐/ tshal bar rbad rbad/ dum bur rbud rbud/ thum myogs baṃ ril/ mā ra ya rbad sod/ ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la raṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ (539)le dam nyams pa'i dgra bo lig ka la bris pa 'di chos kyas srung ma dang shag phyes/ ru tra ma ni ma mas tshe ge bon gyis srung ma dang shag phyes/ ma ma trag rak+sha che ge mkhar gyi rtse lha dang shag phyes/ dhe wa ni mā ra ya che ge dgra lha dang shag phyes/ tsirta ma le tshe ge srog lha dang shag phyes/ na su ye tshe ge zhang lha lha dang gsum dang shag phyes/ nā ga yus pa che ge las lha dag shag phyes/ ka kha ga bha dang lam che ge skyob byed lha bdud dang shag phyes/ gha dzha ṭaha dha bha ye shes che ge skyob byed kyi bcu gsum dang shag phyes/ laṅka grub khung du bcug ste zhags sum rang gi them 'og tu mnan pas lha dang 'bral ngos po/

gsum pa rang gshed dbab pa ni/ hūṃ: su ri'i kha yi phur pa de/ khro bo nag po 'jigs su rung*/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ lag na ral dri lcags kyu thogs/ lte ba man chad sku smad ni/ gnam lcagasaphur pa (540)zur gsum pa/ gang la byed pa'i snying la gzir/ khro bos rnam shes gzir bar bsam/ hūṃ: zur gsum phur pa'i dbal po las/ yungs dkar yung nag ram rgod dang*/ ke tshe shang tshe thang phrom dang*/ zangs phye lcags phye rdo phye dang*/ gdug pa mdzod gyi char phab nas/ phung po dum bur gtub par bsam zhes*/ yak+sha 'og 'i las sngags kyi thun gyas brab/ yang*/ hūṃ: steng gi khro bo'i phur pa yis/ kho yi lha srung pyi bo nas/ drag tu gzir bas ma bzod te/ lan rtsa byad ma rang la ldog ring sngags bdag po rang nyid kyi/ phur pa 'dril zhing gdab pa yis/ kho rang lha srung snying gar phog lhas byin shin tu khros pa yis/ slar phur pa 'dril zhing btab/ srog rtsa bral zhing rnam shes bsad/ rang gshed rang la phog par bsam/ ces tsher nag gi phur pa de laṅka la btab nas/ phur pa'i khro bo de shin tu kros nas phur pa'i dbal po shin tu rgo zhing me 'bar ba de kho yi lha pung gi spyi bo nas drag tu gzir bas ma bzod nas/ (541)lan rtsa byad ma rang la 'dod pas byad mas phur bu 'dril zhing yar khro bo la btab pas kho rag gi lha srung gi snying ngar phog lha srung shin tu khros nas slar la phur pa 'dril zhing byad ma'i snying ngar btab pas srog la gzir zhing rnam shes mar me bzhin du bsad pas rang gshed rang la dbab par bsam la/ las sngags bzla phur thun gyin brab po/ bzhi ba la spyi dgos gnis kyi spyir bsad pa la lus bsad pa ni/ hūṃ/ nga ni dbang chen he ru ka/ sprul par bcas pa'i dus la babs/ khyad par kho yi snying nang du/ ngan sems can gdug pa'i rnam smin te/ lcags bsregs 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ drag sngags dang bcas 'khor ba yis/

snying khrag gtor zhing snying rtsa bcad/ rnam shes mar me bsad par bsam/ dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs kyis/ sha zos khrag 'thung rus pa brlag rdul phan tsam yang med par bsam/ drag sngags kyis gzer zhing thun gyas brab so/ khyad par byad ma dgos kyi sus bsad pa ni/ hūṃ: khyad par kho yi rnam shes las/ gdug(542)pa'i dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis/ spyi bo gshang lam gnyis nas zhugs/ snying gi mgo mjug gnyis nas 'jus/ rnam shes dran 'dzin phud sga dang*/ snying khrag 'ib nas bsad par bsam zhes khyad par kho yi zhe sdang las grub pa'i dug sbrul dmar po gcig spyi bo nas mar zhugs/ dug sbrul non gcig gshang lam nas yar zhugs/ snying gi mjug nas yar 'jus/ rnam shes dang ting nges 'dzin gya nus pa snying khrag thams cad 'jib nas bsad par bsam mo/ ces dang*/ yang las sngags bzla'o/ ngag bsad pa ni/ hūṃ: ngan sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa de/ lce steng lcags bsreg khol ma yi/ sdig nag mgo dgu 'jigs su rung*/ kho yi ge sdig nyes pa dang*/ sngangs kyi nus pa 'jib par bsam/ ngan sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa de kho'i lce yi steng du lcags bsregs kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa zhig gis ngag gi dbang po dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'jib par bsam la/ las sngangs gnam lcags spyi bzlas nas/ byad ma dgos bsad skyi yid bsad pa ni/ hūṃ: bsam pa ngan (543)pa'i rnam smin te/ gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ snying gi nang na 'khor ba yis/ snying khrag gtor wing snying rtsa gcod/ rnam shes kaṃ kaṃ bsad par bsam/ ces dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa'i nram smin te gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa zhig snying gi nang du g.yon skor du sga ra ra 'khor bas snying khrag gtor zhing rnam shes nag gam kam bsad par bsam la/ thub gyis bram phur bu gdab ral dris gtub pa dag bzhi bo rta nag rang gi dgos chos thun min lgas pas phyin chad rgyud don bsgrigs shes pa byung na yi ge 'di'i mthu yin par blta'o/

rgyud las/ de ni byad ma bsad pa'i las/ rang gshed rang la bskor ba'i las/ kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ bsad las dug mda' nag po 'di/ gang la brgyab kyag shor mi srid/ mtshas med lnga las sdig che bas/ phal la ma bstan rang la sdig sangs rgyas bstan dang ngar sprog la/ dgos sa byung na nyes chung zhes/ bco lnga bsreg pa gsum po la/ bsad las de bzhin dgos pas so/ lnga ba darag sngags spyi la gces pa'i tshings gang la sbyor ba'i pad+ma las gru gu 'thul ba dag 'dra ba*/ ting nge 'dzin ( 544) med thabs med pa/ bskul pa med thabs med pa/ sngags med thabs med pa gsu gyi dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha rta nag bsgom ste/ phur pa rta mgrin sku stod khro rgyal sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa gal gyi sol mal nas bton pa ltu rtse la tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i rgya mdud kyi steng du khro bo hūṃ ka ra/ khog seng du rta nag dregs pa sde brgyad dang bas pa gsal zhing hūṃ ka ra'i steng du a dkar po skra ma rgyal lta bu zhig bsam/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a las zla ba/ sor mo lnga la oṃ āḥhūṃ ka ra'i steng du a dkor skra ma rgyal lta bu zhing bsam/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du al las zla ba/ ser mo lnga la oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā las rigs lnga yab lga*/ g.yon pa'i mthil du ma las nyi ma ser mo lnga la muṃ lāṃ maṃ sāṃ tā8 las yum lnga*/ thal mo sbyar bas yab yum zhal sbyor bar

bsam la/ dzaḥhūṃ bam ho/ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ ces phur pa blangs te phur pa bsgril/ cing dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi snying ngar gdab pas gang la btab pa de gzhob thul gyis sorang bar bsam/ liṅga gang ma byed pa dgra dngos su bsam/ bskul pa ni/ dzaḥ dam tshig che po'i dus la babs/ mthu rtsal (545)'don pa'i dus la babs/ dngos grub bar rom pa dang*/ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ gtogs shig grogs dang phrol la thongs: glo snying dmor phyung la shog ma mayel ma g.yel las mdzod cig sus la bab po sa ma ya/ ces bskul nasasngags 'bod rbad bsad gsum dril bas bsad/ de yang sngags snying ma rang gi sngags spyi dril gyis phur pa gdab cing bsad par bya/ sngags gsar ma ba rnams rang ngar gi mgon po'i sngags gzhi nying gcig tu dris bas bsad do/ drang srong gi med mo bya ba ni/ nga ni srid gsum kun gyi bdag nga ni srog gcod kun gya bdag nga ni srog snying kun gyi bdag sde rgyad srog snying nga la yod/ bcol ba'i las rnams khyed kyas sgrubs/ gal te bka' la mi gnas na/ na raka dbyal ba chen por skye/ de bas dam las ma 'da' zhig hoḥ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di srid pa spyi nas shig cig srid gsum rming nas sgyel cig/ 'khor ba gting nas phyungs shig bskal pa'i mes sregs (546)shig drang srong gi bka' yi dmod paras bsdigs shig bka' yi cha dpa nam mkha'i dbyings nas ched cig gnam lcags kyi thog dag ser ba ral dris spyi gtsug la rgyob cig mgo tshal sa brgya ru thong zhig snying dum bu stog du thong zhig lus dum bu stong du gtubs shig rdo rje'i ser ba chen po phob cig dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa phung du chag cig ces thun gyis brab/ de nas khrag thun/ de nas dug thun/ de nas mda' thun/ dug khrag brab spu gra la shams su/ dgra bo mug myogs myogs/ ces kha la dug chu gtig go/ de nas phur pa 'debs pa'i tshig 'dis bskul te/

hūṃ: dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed na/ stobs chen khro bo thugs khros nas/ rdo rje me yi ser ba dang drag po sngags kyi 'brug sgra yis/ brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ dgra bgegasasrag rtsa len par byed/ hūṃ: stong gsu stong ga 'jig rten na/ byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ lcags sam (547)drag po'i shing dag la/ drag po'i phur pa zur gsum pa/ rtse mo gru gsum rgya mdud ldan/ legs la drog lha bsgom nas/ btab pas dgra bgegs thal bar brlag brlag par ma gyur gang yang med/ mngon spyod lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ hūṃ: sku stong khro rgyal 'bar ba la/ sku smad lcags phur zur gsu pa/ rgya mdud rtse nas 'brug sgra sgrog btsum gzhog steng nas r+b+ba ltar 'dril/ chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa 'phro/rtse mo'i phyogs nas 'od zer 'bar/ 'od zer 'apro ba'i nus mabru yis/lha yang rung ste dgra bgegs sgrol/ dgra bo'i srog rtsa len par byed/ btab pa med kyang dmyal bar 'gyur/ bsgril zhing bsgril zhing btab tsa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dbyings su spra/ ces phur pa btab po/ de yang phur pa dgra bo'i bla gnas par gdab/ de nas snying ga'i nṛ la gdab/ snying gi dkyil ngan khrag gi sbal ba bye'u'i snying tsam yod pa de la yid kyi rnam shes gnas yod pas de la gdab/ de nas lus (548) kyi rnam shes gnas pa'i sa ste ba la gdab/ ngag gi rnam shes kha la/ mig gi rnam shes mig la/ sna yi rnam shes sna ma/ rna bde rnam shes rna ba gnis la/ lce yi rnam shes lce la/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gsang ba la gdab/ spyi gtsug dang rkang mthil la re re gdab/ las sngags spu gri brjod bzhin btab pas phur pa gar btab btab la dbal nub par bsam/ yang phur pa snying gar btab nas 'byung ba la 'byung ba bstim nas bsad pa ni/ sa chu la thim/ chu me la thim/ me rlung la thim/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim/

kho'i bkrag mdangs rnamasaphur pa la thim nas phur pa'i khong seng la don/ rang gi snying ga'i nṛ la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ yang phur pa btab pas kho'i rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad po yang phurapa la 'dus sa tim par bsam/ yang phur pa btab pas kho'i rnam par shes pa phur pa la 'dus/ phur pa 'do du zhu nas hūṃ ka ra la 'dus/ hūṃ ka ra steng gi a la 'dus/ a de rang gi snying gar 'dus/ rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzig brjid dang ldan de tshe dang bsod nas rgyas par bsam/ yang phur pa snying ngar btab pas snyig gi dkyil na khrag gi sbal ba (549) la btab pas kho'i rnam shes kyi rten dngul chu zhun ma 'drab bye'u'i snying tsam gcig yod pa de la phur pa btab pas/ kho'i rnam par shes pa phur pa la 'ub kyas bsdus par bsam/ phur pa de 'o ma'i rgyal pa bzhin dkar mer gyis song*/ phur pa cer gyis bton pas dgra bo 'ub gyis song*/ phur pa rang gi snying ngar gtad la/ a be sha ya āḥ ces brjod pas/ dgra bo'i bkrag dang gzi mdangs tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang gi snying ngar thim pas rag nid tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ yang pur pa kho'i snying ngar btab pas kho'i rnam shes hūṃ gyur nas/ yaṃ las rlung gis btegs nas 'og gi rnam du dpal chen po yab yum gyi sbyob mtshams su btag bas/ rgyal ba'isras su skyes par bsam/ phur rtse gyen du brtan te/ phaṭa brjod do/ man ngag 'di dag ldan na sems can grang samed bsgral yang las kyi sgrib pa til 'bru tsam mi gos par ma zad tshags dpag med rdzogs par rgyal bas gsungs/ man ngag med pa'i las sbyor gang byer glob pa'ingo ma tshad yin/ byas pa'i bab col yin/ smon pa'i las dang khyad par med/ des na gab pa mngon phyug 'di ni/ lusami gsod/ sems ni g.yod/ dgra bgegs kyi bla rtags g.yasod pa'i las yin no/ de nas gso ba gsum gyi (550)bdag gos ba ni/

rtsa sngags brgya bzla/ hūṃ: brgya bzla pas/ kham gsum hūṃ gis gang nas hūṃ rnams rang gi thugs kar thi pas bdag nyid sku che la tags par bsam/ phur pa gso ba ni/ rtsa sngags dang las sngags sbrel la bzlas pas/ phur pa de las phur pa grangs med pa 'phros/ slar phur pa la thim pas phur pa de bkrag gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ dgra gso ba ni rtsa sngags brgya bzlas pas sngags kyi 'do zer kho'i snying ngar tim pas tshogs gis rdzogs shing sgrib pa sbyangs nas kho dpal rta mgrin tshon gang ba gcig tu gyur pa de rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyis btegs nas dpal chen po yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su phog pas rgyal ba'i sras su skyes par bsam la/ oṃ oṃ brgya bzlas pas/ chos sku thob par bsam/ āḥ.āḥbargyas/ long sku thob par bsam/ hūṃ hūṃ brgyas/ spul sku thob par bsam mo/ gso ba phyi ma 'di pha rol po sgrol zin pa la bya ba las/ deng sang bsgral las re dang sbyar gyin 'dug pa man ngag gi gnad ma zin pa'i las su shes par bya'o/ de nas ling ro gtun tu bcug la/ gtun dbang chen gyi sa gzhir/ rdo rje rje pha lam ri rab tsam gyis brdung bar bsam te/ dzaḥ zhes bkug te/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i gun khung du/ rdo rje pha lam the bas brdung*/ lha yag rung (551)ste bgegs kyang sgrol/ dam nyams dgra bo'i tshe srog ched/ kha thams cad kha thams cad mchu tshings mchu chings/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas la brdung ngo/ de nas lig ro zhal du bstab pa ni/ mi rkang gzar bu'i nang du blugs te/ hūṃ: mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor na/ ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal/ yak+sha nag po mthu bo che/ stobs ldan nag po'i zhal du stob/ dreg pa sde brgya zhal su stob/srog bdag nag po'i= las mkhan nag po'i= shan pa nag po'i= mon pa nag po'i= gnam pa cam gyi zhal phyes shig gangs ri tsam gyis mche gachigs shig nyi zla tsam gyi spya gyis gzigs/ glog dmar tsaṃ gyi ljags rkyongs shig

bstab po basba po zhal su bstab/ bstab po rta mgrin zhal= dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du= gsol cig rol cig kha ram khā hi/ stong gsum hū= sgra di ri ri/ khams gsum phaṭa sgra di ri ri/ srid gsu ha sgra di ri ri/ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la=(552)ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la= ma hā ko re tsa na la= ma hā tsirta la = ma ha' ba su ta la= ma hā zhing chen la khā hi/ sngags lan bdun gyis zhal du bstab yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ ling ro phal cher lha la stob/ phal cher mer bsreg thal ba mnan par bya bani snga 'gyur ba'i drag sngags spyi 'gros lags kyang*/ da ni mchog dman su la mkho tshod ma red/ go sa dang thob thang snyem 'chang*/ phrag dog 'gran sems kun slong*/ bgrigs 'grigs grwa pa'i phyag len/ zhwa gos ber shams brjid kyis/ skad ro dbyangs rol bskyon pa/ sngags kyi gzugs brnyan tsaṃ las/ ha tsang sngags par rlom pa/ rnying rnan dmus long rnams la/ drag sngags snying po'i phyogs kyi/ dmigs bu 'di na phyes bas/ dam pa'i bla ma brten nas/ gdams pa'i gnad gsang phyes nas/ bstan 'gro'i don chen brtson dgos/ rak+sha'i phreng ba bzung nas/ rnga brdung bon khyer byed pa'i/ grong sngags skya min ser min/ rang gzhan mgo bo la skor/ ces so/ drug pa las bcu gnyis pa lalas dgra gegs spyir bsad pa dang*/ byad ma dgos dkyi bsad pa gnyis gzhung du song nas/ bye brag pa gdon chen 'dul ba'i las byed na/ btso (553) sngo bsregs su gye dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum par dur khrodakyi rdo sra ba gsumagyisabaskyed pu gsum btsug de steng mgon zangs nang du chu gtsang mas bkang*/ gser g.yu dung gsum gri chung bcas pa'i mgon rten dang*/ stog du shing gi am bhi la drag po'i gtor ma bsha nas/ stong las nyi ma shar ba'i bzlas pa khyad par bco sngags dang bca pa bzlas nas/ rmad dril gru gu 'thul ba la/ dz+wa la ram gyis me sbar te/

oṃ swa bha was stog par sbyang nas/ stong pa'i ngag las rdo rje gasrung ba'i gur khag gi dbus su gru gsum mthing na 'bar ba'i dbus su mgon chu rta mgrin nag po mdun bskyed ltar gsal bad nga stong gi gtor ma yag de bzhin du bskyed nas spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar du btang*/ las sngags rgyang ba dang btso sngags snga ma dang*/ oṃ bram ze dkar nag mgo la sad de la rbad swā hā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas nas/ mdun bsnyed kyi rta mgrin 'od du zhu nas khro chu khol ma lta bur gyur par bsam/ zhes gon zangasaskyi chu bskol/ bskul pa nas bsad pa las bzhi yan chad byas de/ shug los myon chu gnas khag dang nad pa sogs la gtor zhing*/ las sngags skyes gzir zhing lcag gis brab/ de nas myon zangs du gnod byed bkug la dgra chos kyis (554) gtor ma brteg/ mgon zangs sbubs la rta bro brdung ba rnams gzhung gis dngos bstan lags/ rgyas par spro na rtsags med phyag len gyas pa byon/ kaḥthog pa nyi ma dh+ma nas brgyud par gsungs sa bon lugs dang mthun shas che/ gnyis pa rngo ba'i las byed na/brum la dur rdo'i sgyed pur/ rabs chad nag po'am/ yugs pa stag lo ma'i mar nag dug sna sbyar ba tshar mi mes bskol/ sdeng du gnod byed kyi liṅka bca'/ me thab mdun bskyed ltar gsal te spyen nas bstod pa'i bar du btang nas/ slang nga khro bo'izhal du gsal/ mar khu dug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil bar/ liṅka la bskyed ba dang bsad pa las bzhi bya/ chang dang bul togs gis sngags thun brdeg me 'bar bas gnod dam dang dngos su bsreg par bsam la/ las sngags rkyang ba brjod/ gter ma brdeg pa sogs gong ltar ro/ gsum pa bsreg pa las ni/ yang phyung nag po'i sgo nas sbyi bsregs dbyer med 'dod pas/ mchod pa dang sman raka gtor ma rnams gzhung ltar bsham nas/ khyad par du phung shul lam/ dur khrod kyi sa la me thab grum brtsigs

dur po sa gyis byugs me thab gyi dbus su hūm̐ nag po zhig bri/ shing tshor ma can gru gsum du brtsigs/ bsregs dgra bgegs gang la bya ba'i liṅga nyer gcig mig yig nyer gcig ba ling nyer gcig sha dum nyer gcig (555) rak+ta dang bcas g.yang gzi logs pa'i gdan du bshams/ de nas bdag bas+khayed bzlas pa dang bas pa byas nas/ de nas liṅka dang ba ling ming sogs la rak+ta bran la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu byin gyis brlabs te/ dz+wa la ram̐ gyis mdun gyi me thab la me spar nas/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyang nas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngag las grum mthig nag me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil du/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams gan rgyal du mnan pa'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ drag po'i spyan gsum bsgrad cing smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas sgrol byed kyi ral dris dgra bgegs sum buragatubs pa/ g.yon 'dzin byed kyilcags kyus dgra bgegs kyi srog snying 'dren pa/ zhabs gnyis dgra bgegs non pa/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba/ spyi gcug na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad drag po nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba (556)khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsumazil gyis gnon pa/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ sku smad la stag gi sham thabs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu gnyis do shal byas pa/ ba spru'i gsheb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ dbu skra gnam lcags kyi rol pa bsigs pa'i sgra gseb nas kro chungagi tsogs dpag tu med pa phyir 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ khro chung thams cad tsur 'dus bsrung ba'i gur du gyur/

ces gsal btab nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod 'bul/ bstod pa yan rdzogs nas bskul pa nas bsad pa las bzhi'i bar btang nas/ de nas bsreg rdzas liṅka re/ nya bo re/ ba ling re/ sha dum re/ rak+ta re bcas grags la bsreg skyong nang du blugs shing 'bul/ rtsa sngags dang las sngags sbrel ba'i shams/ dgra gegs gnod byed mā ra ya dz+wa la ram ram/ ces/ me lce rta mgrin kho bo'i tsogs kyis gra bgegs dngos su gsol bar bsam/ rdzas sngags nyer gcig rdzosags par bya (557)de nas gtor ma la sman raka gis bran te gzhung gi gtor sngags kyis 'bul/ gtor ma dag bo dngos su gsal te dpal rta mgrin gyi zhal brum du gdangs ba'i nang du 'phang*/ gtoram log na babaskyar las 'phrang*/ rjes bzod gsol yig brgya bzla/ me thab gi ye shes pa/ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ me dmigs pas rgyas gdab/ me thabs stong du bro brdung*/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ thal ba lam rgya gram legs par mnan par bya'o/ ༈ de nas mnan pa'i las byed na/ sngags pa gshin rje'i lag tu gtad/ gri thod mdze thod na du brub/ sngags pa'i dben khang zhabs su mnan/ gan+de rgyal po'i lag tu gtad/ khyi tham sprel thod nang du blugs/ lha khag 'dre can 'og tu mnan/ skye bo gri btsan lag tu gtad/ sha khyi dmag po'i thod par grub/la btsas gong bu dmar po mnan/ bud med srin mo'i lag tu gtad/ khyi mo nag mo'i thod par grub/ mchod rten rnyig ba'i 'og tu mnan/ byis pa the'u rang lag tu gtad/ ra kham thod pa'i nang du brub/ brag phun stong ba'i sgo khar mnan/ sri'u chung sri'i lag tu gtad/ byi la nag mo'i thod par grub/ tsa ti rnying ba'i 'og tu mnan/ pha tshan che na klu la gtad/ glag dmar rwa yi nang du brub/ chu mig

(558) gnyan po'i 'gram du mnan/ ma tshan che na gza' la gtad/ gza' ra rog po'i thaud par grub/ rgya lam bsnams mi 'og tu mnan/ bgegs la gtad na so so yi/ thod pa rang rang gnas su mnan/ ces de ltar las sbyor gang byed kyang*/ yak+sha nṛ tri hur thu dzaḥsogs gag las byed pa'i srog them sbyar nas mnan par bya'o/ yang samayo 'bogs 'dul ba'i las byed na/ dang po smro 'arje brtags pa ni/ nam mkhar lta na rgyal po yin/ ngo 'bod byed na bsen mo yin/ skad ngan 'don na 'gong bo yin/ sbrong sbrog rdugs la bdud rigs yin/ gzer zhing 'phags na batshan rigs yin/ rgyang glu len na sman rigs yin/ sngags zhing 'dar na chu gri yin/ 'gag cing 'bogs na 'gag 'dri yin/ rgod cing 'bogs na the'u rang yin/ 'dzum zhing 'bogs na byad 'dre yin/ smyo zhing rengs la bcos mi phan/ rtsa rgyus 'chug gam sngon las yin/mig rtsa dmar zhing mig 'gyur na/ cis kyang gdon gyis btab pa'i rtags/ gsungs ba nges par byas nas/ rang nyid rta mgrin khros pa'i nga rgyal la gnas nas/ nad pa'i srin lag yon pa nas bzung la bdug rdzas kyis bdug phur pa sngags dang bcas pas mgo la gzir nas/ rtsa sngags las sngags sbrel nas thun gyis brab pas/ lha 'dre rang ming ston cig gnod pa mi byer par khas len na glud yas (559) byin la bskrad/ mi phan na drag po'i gtor bzlog dang*/ ces ma phan na btso rngo bsreg pa'i las byed nas mnan pas mtha' sdud bya'o/ yag rgyal bsen legs gdon chen btul ba'i man ngag smad las kya las sngags spu gri'i shams la/ tri rā tsa rgyal po'i tsirta zung zung*/ rā tsā kha rag sme sha rbad rbad/ 'khu na rā tsa'i snying la dum bur shig shig da na rā tsa'i snying rtsa phyung phyung*/ ldog na rā tsa'i tsirta gtub gtub/ a tri ya ya tri ya/ ma tri ya matri ya/ ma zhun tri ya broṃ dzaḥbro8 dzaḥ rā tsa tri hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ bsen mo tri hur thuṃ dzaḥ

mā ra ya rbad/ ces rtags ma byung bar bzla'o/ slar 'tshub che na smad las bsad pa las bzhi dang bco rngo bsreg pa gang rung bya'o/ yang gdug dang gzir med man ngag la/ 'bre gdon sbyo 'bogs gang 'dul yang*/ bdug rdzas ro skra ba spru dang*/ mu zi 'ba' cha rbad phye dang*/ l+h+wam 'bogs se ba'i bsreg nad pa sa phug brag phug gi phug tu bcug la mdo bgags la/ dud pas bdug ci drag sngags bzla las sngags gnam lcags spu gri'i shams/ oṃ badz+ra (560)yak+sha gnod byed 'byung po'i tsirta zung zung*/ kha rag sme sha rbad rbad/ 'khu na du bur shig shig 'da' na rak+sha tsirta phyung phyung*/ ldog na rak+sha myogs myogs/ rbad rbad/ tri gtub gtub/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ra tsa si ti a ha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā tsa thum a ti rbad/ rak+sha rak+sha thuṃ krag ti rbad/ rā tsa su tri tri nan pod/ rā tsa ma ti rbad/ lu lig tsa pa tsirta rbad/ tri badz+ra tri badz+ra ya ma rā tsa tu tri phu tri mā ra ya sed/ na ga tun tsin+dha mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni hūṃ phaṭa/ phye mar shig shig rdul du nan/ rbad rbad sod sod/ ces drag tu gzir cing thun gyis brab/ gdug pa 'dar zhing skad ngan tser tser len/ de nas srin lag tu tshon skud btags/ yungs kar yungs nag lcags pye zangs phye'i thun brteng*/ zhing lpags kyis brdab cing ming nas dri/ migi na pa dang bskrad rdzas gtad/ phyis gnod pa byed ro'i mna' 'gag gzir ba drag pos mtshams bcad/ lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyang dpag tshad tsam du yod mi nus shing*/ mi yang srin po mthong ma 'dra/ shin+tu gnyan (561) pas gsang bar bya'o/ ༈ bdun pa bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba la mnga' gsol zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ: dpal ldan ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal/ khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo/ bla mar mnga' gsol tshad med thugs rje can/ khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo/ yi dam mnga' gsol byams mgon spyan ras gzigs/

khyed la mchod cing = dpa' bor mnga' gsol rta mgrin dbang gi lha/ khyed la = khro bor mnga' gsol gnam lcags ral pa can/ khyed la= mgon por mnga' gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ khyed la= chos skyong mnga' gsol ma hā ka la che/ khyed la= bstan srug mnga' gsol lha chen chos kyi bdag khyed la= las mkhan mnga' gsol yak+sha mthu bo che/ khyed la= shan par mnga' gsol gnod sbyin srog la rngam/ khyed la= tshar gcod mnga' gsol phyag g.yas ral gri brnams/ khyed la= rjes 'dzin mnga' gsol phyag g.yon/ (562)lcags kyu 'dzin/ khyed la= zil gnon mnga' gsol dar nag ber chen gsol/ khyed la = dbangadrag mnga' gsol spyi gtsug rta skad 'tsher/ khyed la = yon tan mnga' gsol dpal gyi cha lus can/ khyed la = sprinal las mnga' gsol srid gsum gdug pa 'dul/ khyed la = lhu dbang mnga' gsol lha rnams zil gyis gnon/ khyed la = stobs ldan mnga' gsol dregs pa las la bskul/ khyed la= ye shes ma'aga'agasol me dpug dbus na bzhugs/ khyed la= 'jig rtan mnga' gsol sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyod/ khyed la= dam chen mnga' gsol sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*/ khyed la= dgra lhar mnga' gsol dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod/ khyed la= rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed la mnga' gsol bas khyed kya sku dang gsung gi rgyud mnyes nas/ yon tan phrin las stobs kyis rtsal phyungs la/ bstan pa'i dgra bgegs ma rung rdul du rlog bdag cag yon (563)mchod 'khor bcas bsrung su gsol/ mimathun rkyen bzlog bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces dang bzlog pa ni/ kyai/ yang cig thugs rje chen po snyan gson dang*/ rta mgrin rgyal po snyan gson dang*/ nag po chen po snyan= yak+sha nag po= 'khor gyi dregs pa= pho nya las mkhan snyan gson dang*/ khyed ni sngon gyi thams dam can/ bdag ni rnor sgrub pa po/ bdag gis khyed la mchod cing gsol/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ dus la bab po dmam tshig can/ bzlog bsgyur prin las bcol ba ni/

sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung*/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten du/ ru tra sade gsum dar ba'i tshe/ dpal chen rigs gsum myon po yis/ drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams/ gsangs sngags mthu yi rga chen brdung*/ rig sngags thun gyi zer chen 'dril/ ru tra sde gsum gtan nas brlag de nas bzlog pa gar srid na/ sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas su/ lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe/ lha dbang rgyal po(564)stobs chen gyis/ drag po dpal gyi gtor che bshams/ gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdung*/ rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril/ lha min g.yul ngo bzlog par mdzad/ de nas bzlog pa gar srid na/ rgya gar rdo raje gdan drung du/ mu stegs dmag tshogs rgol ba'i tshe/ slon dpon shākaya seng ge yis/ drag po dpa gyi gtor chen bshams/ gsang sngags mthu yi rga chen brdung*/ rig sngags thun gyi zer chen 'dril/ mu stegs dmag tshogs pham par mdzad/ sngon byung srid pa de bzhin du/ da lta sngags sgrub pa pos/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi phying bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams/ gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdung*/ rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril/ mi mthun bar chad bzlog gyur cig bh+yo/ drag po dpa gyi gtor chen 'di/ gsang sngags 'du ba'i byin rlabs yin/ rig sngags 'du ba'i mchon cha yin/ khro bo 'du ba'i mthu rtsal yin/ khro mo 'du ba'i drag tsal yin/ pho (565)nya 'du ba'i las mkhan yin/ sde brgyad 'du ba'i dmod mo yin/ 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med/bdag cago na mchod 'khor dang bcas la/ chags che nyams mchis pa yang*/ bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog sngon gyi las las gyur pa yang*/ bzlog go= 'phral gyi rkeyan las gyur pa yang*/ bzlog go= yas kyi bdud kha g.yos pa yang*/ bzlog go= mas kyi sri kha sdang ba yang*/ bzlog go dmar chen pha rol rbod gtong gtong ba yang*/

bzlog go= tshe la bar du gcid pa yang*/ bzlog go= srog la hur thum 'byung ba yang*/ bzlog go= lus kyi 'byung ba 'khyugs pa yang*/ bzlog go= dus min 'chi ba thams cad kyang*/ bzlog go= he ru ka yi drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= khro tshogs yab gyi drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= ma tshogs yab yum gyi drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= pho nya las kyi drag sngags kyang*/ (566)bzlog go= myon pos dmod pas drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= gshin rjes dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= gnod sbyin dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= pho rgyu dmod pa'i drag sngangs kyang*/ bzlog go= mo rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= lha rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= glu rnams dmod pa'i drag sngangs kyang*/ bzlog go= /gnyan rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /gza' rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /bdud rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /batshan rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /ru tras dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /ma yam dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /'gong pos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /rgyal pos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /bsen mos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /the'u rang dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /sa bdag dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ (567)bzlog go mu stegs dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /bgegs rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang*/ bzlog go= /lha yi dal zor 'phen pa yang*/ bzlog go= /lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yang*/ bzlog go= /gza' rgod kig kag 'beb pa yang*/ bzlog go= /gshi chen 'khor lo bskor ba yang*/ bzlog go= /ma mos khrag nad gtong ba yang*/ bzlog go= /'chi bdag kram la btab pa yang*/ bzlog go=

/bdud kyi zhags pa 'phen pa yang*/ bzlog go= /btsan gyi jag sna rgyug pa yang*/ bzlog go= /rgyal pos smyo 'bogs gtor ba yang*/ bzlog go= /'byung pos bar chad byed pa yang*/ bzlog go= /gnod sbyin za kha ston pa yang*/ bzlog go= / sa bdag khram la btab pa yang*/ bzlog go= /klu yis gtad khram bcug pa yang*/ bzlog go= /the'u rang sris la rku ba yang*/ bzlog go= /sa bdag khram la btab pa yang*/ bzlog go= /klu yis gtad khram bcug pa yang*/ bzlog go= /the'u rang sris la rku ba yang*/ bzlog go= /mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa yang*/ bzlog go= /ban+de rig sngags byed pa yang (568) bzlog go= /bon pos mthu sgrub byed pa yang*/ bzlog go= /skye bos mda' zor bsham pa yang*/ bzlog go= /bu med dug zorabashams pa yang*/ bzlog go= /bgegs ring stong phrag brgyad cu yang*/ bzlog go= /na rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yang*/ bzlog go= /ked rigs sum brgya drug cu yang*/ bzlog go= /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yang*/ bzlog go= /ye 'dre+og sum brgya drug cu yang*/ bzlog go= /dus min 'chi ba bced brgyad bzlog go= /me ltas mtshan ma ngan pa yang*/ bzlog go= /pha tshan nang gi rgyab 'dre yang*/ bzlog go= /ma tshan nga gi phye 'dre yang*/ bzlog go= /dar tshan nang gi steng 'dre yang*/ bzlog go= /dar sri gzhon sri chung sri yang*/ bzlog go= /brgya yi mi kha zug pa yang*/ bzlog go= /stog gi bra mchu zug pa yang*/ bzlog go= /ma nyes kha yog ngan pa yang*/ bzlog go= /mi yi na tsha thams cad kyang*/ bzlog go= (569)nor gyi god kha thams cad kyang*/ bzlog go= /zhing gi btsa' pad ser gsum yang*/ bzlago go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/ bzlog bsgyur phrin las bcol ba bzhin/ bsgyur ro ltas ngan mtsher rtsab bsgyur/ bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab/ dus la bab po sa ma ya/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ de nas dkar gtor gser skyems skyes zor lam phyes nas/

bcu ba chad tho btang nas/ gtor chen dgra phyogs su zhal bstan la/ hūṃ: nga ni kro bo rta mgrin sku/ nga ni khro bo kun gyi gtso/ nga ni snang srid kun gyi bdag khams gsum srid gsum nga yi zas/ che ba'i lha rnams dang yi 'khor/ mthu chen stobs ldan zil gyis gnon/ ga yi thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal/ yak+sha nag po mthu bo che/ las mkhan gnam lcags ral pa can/ rab 'jigs gnod sbyin nag po rngams/ steng nas khro zhing chas tsa na (570)steng gsum kun kyang shogs se shig gnam pa kun kyang 'u ru ru/ ri rab kun kyang sga ra ra/ rgya mtsho kun kyange re re/ nyi zla gza' skra cha la la/ rigs drug sems can nyi li li/ lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra/ mkha' yi 'brug sgra 'u ru ru/ bar snang gralog dmar khyugs se khyug/ gnam lcags ser chen khra la la/ rlung nag 'tshub ma gyi li li/ bskal pa'i med 'bar lam se lam/ mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa spungs se spung*/ bskul lo stobs ldan nag po che/ rbad de dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs/ chos shig sadang ba'i dgra la chos/ stobs ldan nag po dgra la chos/ yak+sha nag po dgra= gnod sbyin nag po= ru tra nag po dgra= srog bdud nag po= las mkhan nag po= shan pa nag po= mon pa nag po dgra la chos// lha dmag 'bum dang dgra la chos// klu dmag 'bum dang = gnyan dmag 'bum dang = bud dmag 'bum dang =(571)btsan dmag 'bum dang = ི nag 'bum dang = bya nag 'bum dag = khyi nag 'bum dang = mi rta phyes la nang tshang dkrug dpon po pod la dmag mi gter/ dag yi bu rta tsham la pheb/ dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsadanas chod/ dgra bo'i mo rgyud mngal nas skoṃ/ dgra bo'i rigs rgyud mtha' nas sdus/ dgra bo'i bla ri rmang nas shig dgra bo'i bla mtshe gtig nas skol/ dgra bo'i bla shing sked nas chog dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas thob/ dgra bo'i yul mkhar rlung la skur/ gtor ma 'di dang 'gro gnyis/

mnyam por bzhes la med par mdzod/ kyai/ sangs rgyas chos la dgra byung na/ srung ma dam chen ra mda' sdog rem cig chos skyong mtha rtsal can/ chos shig dgra dang bgegs la chos/ myon mongs pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos/ ma mo'i (572)dmag tshogs= gshin rje'i dmag tshogs= gnod sbyin dmag tshogs= lha yi dmag tshogs= klu yi dmag tshogs= gnyan gyi= gza' yi= bdud kyi dmag= batshan gyi= rgyal po'i= 'gong bo'i= the'u rang dmag= sa bdag= yu lha'i= zo dor dmar= dmag tsogs dgra la chas tsa na/ batshan po gyon la rnon po thogs/ go cha sdom la mtshon cha phyor/ myogs pa zhon la ring bar rgyugs/ dang po'i go gyon lhubs se lhub/ myogs pa'i rta rgyug sbrengs se sbreng*/ shan pa'i mtshon cha zangs se zang*/ ku bswo cha sgra di rir ri/ dar nag ru mtshon su ru ru/ nad kyi na bun thibs se thib/ ye shes kyi rlang pa phyu ru ru/ khrag gi ser ba hri li li/ dug gi khu 'phang sha ra ra/ matson gyi char ba sa li li/ sngags kyi sa don sa'abrug sgra 'u ru ru/ thun gyi thog mda' khyugs se khyug zon gyi thog mda' chems se tshem/ zor mda' dgra bo'i sning la rgyab bo/ mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig (573)gtad do gner ro dgra dang bgegs/ sod cig thul cig med par mdzod/ bsad rtag don snying khyer la shog gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog sa yi rten phur phud la shog /tshe yi 'du byed sdus la shog /srog gi 'apar thag chod la shog sems kyi mar me sod la shog dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang phyes/ mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang sprod/ las kyi gshin chen shan pa yis/ pho rgyu rnams kyi sha la zo/ mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung*/ gcan gzan rnams kyis nang khrol zo/ nang dbung phyi ru 'dren du chug khong khrag kha nas sgyur su chug 'o dod gnamadu 'bod du chug yan lag brag du rdung du chug yar sha mar sha dgra sha zo yar sha mar sha dgra krag 'thung*/
phar sha tshur sha dgra rus mur/ til 'bru tsaṃ yang med par mdzod/ mā ra ya yi dus (574)la bab/ bcol pa'i prin las grub par mdzod/

ces spu gri'i sngags bzlas nas gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo/ de nas brtan ma brkyang*/ rta bro brdung ngo o rgyan mkha po'i thugs kyi ga dang ba mchog nā na klu 'dul rgyud las gab pa yi/ rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can zhes pa/ mtsho rgyal rje la brnog chos bstsal ba las/ bsad pa las bzhi las rim bdun pa zhes/ mkhas pa phal gyis phyogs tsam thos na yang*/ ji bzhin khrol ba'i man ngag gnad med pas/ sprang po'i rna bar phyug po'i bang*/ mdzod bzhin/ 'dod dgu spyod pa'i re ba'i yid bral/ blun som bzlas pa'i grangs la snyem 'chang nas/ btso ngo bsreg pa'i pho tshod byed pa rnams/bon lugs chos dang bsre ba'i lag len 'dis/ smyon pa ji bzhin rang gzhan phung la sbyor/ des na rgyad bla ma'i man ngag dang*/gu ru'i byin rlabs ring du brkyang ba'i drin/ rgyud don gsang ba drag sngags gnad gsang rnams/ des tsam mthong bas gsal bar byed pa po/ skye ba'i phreng bar lha mchog 'di nyid kyis/ brkang ba'i bin rlabs dngos grub char chen po/ yid la 'jo ba pad+ma las (575)(575) 'brel gyis/ rag bzo ma yin rgyud kyi dasang po bzhugs/ dge bas bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ 'phags mchog phyag na pasmo'i phrin las dang*/ mnyam nas snyigs ma'i rgud pa kun zi nas/ lha mchog khyed dag dbyer med 'grub par shog zhes dpal dbang chen rta nag lcags ral can gyi las rim bdun pa kun la rlung ltar grags na'angi bzhin nyams su blang ba'i phyag len ma mthong bas/ rang gzhan ku la phan pa'i phyir pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel//
